title: Why your L.O.I. looks Stupid
description:
Let’s be real—most Letters of Intent (LOIs) look straight-up stupid. In this video, we break down the common mistakes buyers make when drafting an LOI, from offering zero money down to vague terms that turn sellers off instantly. If you’re serious about buying a business, your LOI needs to reflect it. We’ll walk through the red flags, the rookie moves, and how to craft an LOI that actually gets taken seriously—and gets the deal done.
